name: Tanning and spray tan

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: express spray tan
services.story: The main story: an express spray tan at Lee Tan Studio with Jade, $45. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee, and Alex pays at the front desk.

services.name: express spray tan (5-tan pack)
services.story: A 5-tan pack, $200, paid in full when booking. Each tan uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: mobile spray tan at home
services.story: The main story: a mobile spray tan at Alex's home with Marco, $95. A card is saved for the $50 fee, and Rosie texts the bill after the tan.

services.name: express mobile tan, paid in full
services.story: An express mobile tan at home, $75, paid in full when booking.

services.name: bridal party for 5, at a venue
services.story: A bridal party for 5 at a venue, $450: a $100 deposit when booked, and the rest billed after the tans.

services_shape: one spray tan per visit, with a tech the client picks or any free one; packs of tans; a home or venue visit for a party
questions_before_times: the tan wanted (express, full-body or bridal) and the shade wanted (light, medium or dark)
a tech by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
at home or at a venue: the town, the place, and how many people
for a bridal party: the date and the time of the wedding
safety_stop: a rash, blisters, hives, swelling, burning skin, a skin infection, or an open sore or cut in the area
trouble breathing, chest pain, or fainting
license: none checked by Rosie: spray tanning has no state license in most places; a technician's certificate or training is the business's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
staff_skills: express, full-body and bridal spray tans in light, medium and dark shades; eye and lip protection; no DHA tan for a client whose form names an allergy
messages_never: skin answers, allergies, pregnancy, medicines, a doctor's note and the tech's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
